title: Gilgamesh Handoff-Request v1
description: The typed delegation contract Gilgamesh emits via ECL PROPOSE — UPWARD, to the orchestrator, never by dispatching a subagent (AC-E09, R-007, HC8). Delegation triggers on an information/authority/modality boundary, never on perceived complexity (digest §5): evidence_of_boundary is REQUIRED and must name which boundary is crossed. The orchestrator owns routing; Gilgamesh is a worker, never a router.

objective.description: Single-sentence goal of the delegated sub-mission.

paths.description: The bounded path set the delegate may touch.

mode.description: The access mode requested for the delegate.

deliverables.description: The separable, named deliverable(s) the delegate must return.

evidence_required.description: The external evidence format that will prove each deliverable (test output, diff, parser verdict).

stop_conditions.description: The conditions under which the delegate stops (success, budget exhaustion, boundary re-crossing).

suggested_specialist.description: The specialist Gilgamesh believes best fits — advisory only; the orchestrator makes the routing decision.

evidence_of_boundary.description: Why this sub-mission crosses a boundary. Delegation is NEVER justified by 'it looks complex' (digest §5).

boundary_kind.description: The boundary being crossed: a separable information context, an authority Gilgamesh cannot grant itself, or a distinct work modality.

rationale.description: Concrete evidence for the boundary (e.g. 'requires deploy authority Gilgamesh's table denies', 'a modality Gilgamesh cannot verify externally').
